facts.fact: Statistics on Chikaya.ma show over 1,677,000 complaints filed since the January 2018 launch, 111,945 of them from January to 3 September 2025.
The portal gives access to 38 government departments, 116 public institutions and 1,590 local authorities.
Chikaya.ma statistics give 1,406,000 complaints processed (65.46%), an average processing time of 12 days and 60.94% positive feedback.
